name: decisive_power_v3
description: Study v3 (research/protocols/paired_v3_power.md): power-sized and scoped BEFORE the run to the one comparison that can be resolved. MAP-Elites vs fixed-objective GA, paired design, 40 fresh seeds (21-60, disjoint from studies 1 and v2) giving a minimum detectable paired effect of ~0.70 at 80% power. novelty_search is out of scope: the power analysis requires n~321 for the effect it showed. Same task and budget as studies 1/v2; no re-tuning.
